gates.title: Correctness
gates.lens: Trace changed behavior to authoritative producers, callers and contracts. Report concrete regressions, not unrelated existing defects or formatter-owned style.

gates.title: Value and claims
gates.lens: Check the requested outcome, beneficiary, endpoint and claims against observed evidence. Keep value concerns separate from implementation defects; do not invent endorsement or measured impact.

gates.title: Test integrity
gates.lens: Check that meaningful behavior has a failing public-contract test and credible failure coverage. Passing mocks or implementation-token checks do not prove behavior. Correctness owns production defects; this gate owns missing or ineffective verification.

gates.title: Security and recovery
gates.lens: Check evidenced trust boundaries, sensitive data, irreversible effects and recovery. Name a concrete abuse or failure path; do not demand defensive controls for theoretical risks.

gates.title: Protobuf contracts
gates.lens: Review protobuf binary, JSON, generated-source and behavioral contracts through affected consumers. Check presence, schema evolution, codegen, validation enforcement and descriptor-driven behavior. Apply AIP only for APIs adopting its resource conventions. Keep concrete defects separate from advisory schema-driven opportunities; do not require runtime migrations or dispatch agents.

gates.title: Contracts and architecture
gates.lens: Trace non-local compatibility and hard-to-reverse decisions through real producers and consumers. Check generated output as evidence. Do not prescribe architectural changes for taste or hypothetical scale.

gates.title: Surface review
gates.lens: Inspect real surface evidence, states, copy, keyboard behavior and accessibility. Source inspection or unit tests cannot replace rendered evidence. Use terminal evidence for CLI surfaces; do not invent screenshots or launch a human-owned browser.

gates.title: Dependencies and licenses
gates.lens: Check changed direct and transitive dependencies, pins, runtime compatibility, advisories and applicable licenses. Inspect lockfiles and vendored or generated evidence rather than discarding them. Respect the consumer's actual license policy.

gates.title: Documentation
gates.lens: Check that user-visible behavior and technical claims match the implementation and evidence. Update existing documentation rather than demanding new files, sections or diagrams when they add no understanding.

gates.title: Performance
gates.lens: Check claimed or structurally evidenced performance changes at demonstrated scale. Require appropriate measurements for speedup claims; do not invent benchmarks, resource savings or speculative hot paths.

gates.title: Operations
gates.lens: Check changed build, deployment, configuration, observability and recovery contracts against the consuming repository. Require actionable failure signals and rollback where credible risk exists, not generic runbooks or new services.
